description: This file defines an API endpoint for managing an employee's contact details within the OrangeHRM application, including retrieving and updating contact info via RESTful API methods.

classes.name: EmployeeContactDetailsAPI
classes.description: Handles REST API endpoints for retrieving and updating employee contact details, extending the Endpoint class and implementing CRUD operations for contact data.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves contact details for a specified employee using their employee number.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the GET request to fetch a specific employee's contact details.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to retrieve all contact details.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to define validation rules for retrieving all contact details.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to handle creation of contact details.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to define validation rules for creating contact details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an employee's contact details based on provided input payload.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating contact details, including email validation and field length constraints.

methods.name: isUniqueEmail
methods.description: Checks if the provided email is unique for the employee, used to prevent duplicates during update.

methods.name: isValidEmailRecipient
methods.description: Validates the format and characters of email addresses before saving.

methods.name: saveContactDetails
methods.description: Extracts contact details from request parameters, performs validation, updates the employee entity, and saves changes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to handle deletion of contact details.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for delete validation rules.
